designs.name: Tukanova prva fiesta
designs.prompt:
Create ONE original finished invitation BACKGROUND, portrait EXACT aspect ratio 5:7; preferred 1500 x 2100 pixels if supported. The artwork fills the entire image edge to edge, viewed perfectly straight on. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermark, NO mockup, NO paper sheet or paper edges, NO table, NO hands, NO perspective, NO external shadow, NO collage or variations. All important illustrative motifs are fully inside a 5% inset from every edge; only nonessential ground colors may bleed off. Keep the specified calm text zones genuinely uncluttered for large editable Serbian invitation text to be placed later, but DO NOT make the whole image washed out, beige or pastel. Deliberate rich color, clear polished shapes, print quality and charming graphic sophistication.
A joyful FIRST birthday background for a baby boy: a delightful little toucan with a bright yellow and orange beak perched on a small rich teal tropical branch in the LOWER LEFT (roughly x10–42%, y63–88%). A few sculptural turquoise tropical leaves curl underneath him. Saturated CORAL and tangerine ground dominates the whole composition, clean matte gouache/vector hybrid, with crisp lime and sunny yellow accents and a few carefully placed round confetti dots. Keep the TOP 58% mostly a smooth uniform LIGHT CORAL that supports dark navy type; keep the LOWER RIGHT x52–90%, y62–93% clean coral too for details. No faded cream center, no frame, no birthday cake, no balloons, no visible symbols shaped like numerals. Broad lively color fields, not watercolor pale washes. Elegant playful character with correct anatomy, cute and premium.
